ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low overall ratio; approximately 90% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with sparse <10% high-intensity (white/tan) pixel clusters at distal boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black field across central and proximal fluke surfaces; high-intensity contiguous clusters mapped exclusively to the extreme distal tips; diffuse medium-intensity grey mottling visible across the right interior lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 145 degrees; notch depth is approximately 12-15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude serrations (2-5 pixel deviations) along the main lobes; high-amplitude jagged variations (10-20 pixel deviations) at the extreme tips caused by external biological clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve on both lobes, transitioning to an acute convex curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-contrast, roughly circular cluster constellations of white/tan pixels located at the far left and far right terminal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe surface, oriented approximately 45 degrees relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on distal tips; clear linear rake marks on the left fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical jaggedness of the right distal tip compared to the left due to more dense barnacle colonization.
